comparison.objective: Route a lamp cable to a holder while keeping the entire cable clear of a hot-plate exclusion zone.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable cable routing and whole-body hazard avoidance, not rigid threaded adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Plug seated, cable released and resting at prescribed clearance, with any hot-plate crossing causing zero.
comparison.reason: The objective, manipulation mechanics, and outcome are unrelated to stop adjustment and locking.
